title: Northgate Card Missed-Statement Shortfall — Returned and Uncleared Mailed Payments
content:
The shortfall on the missed statement of a past-due **Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.)** account — the amount still owed on that statement toward bringing the account back to good standing — follows what happened to the payments recorded against it:

1. where one of them was returned unpaid, the shortfall is its minimum payment due less those payments net of the returned amounts;
2. where none was returned and one or more of them were mailed and credited in the last month, a month counted back from today to the same calendar day, those mailed payments count only once they clear a month after they were credited, so the shortfall is the minimum payment due less the other payments recorded against it;
3. in every other case the shortfall is the minimum payment due less the payments recorded against it;

a shortfall is never less than zero.

The missed statement is the statement for which the most recent late fee on the account was recorded. A payment is recorded against the statement whose balance it pays, and a returned payment against the same statement as the payment it returns. A mailed payment is one whose payment channel is mail.

| Payments recorded against the missed statement | Shortfall |
|---|---|
| one or more returned unpaid | minimum due less the payments net of the returned amounts |
| none returned; a mailed payment credited within the last month (1 month) | minimum due less the payments other than those mailed payments |
| none returned; no mailed payment credited within the last month | minimum due less all the payments |

## Hypothetical cases (minimum payment due 72.00)

- Payments of 50.00 and 30.00, the 30.00 returned unpaid: 72.00 less 50.00 leaves 22.00.
- A mailed payment of 40.00 credited on the 21st of last month and a phone payment of 10.00, with today the 20th: the mailed payment has not yet cleared, so 72.00 less 10.00 leaves 62.00. Had it been credited on the 20th of last month, it would have cleared, and 72.00 less 50.00 leaves 22.00.
- Payments of 90.00, none returned or mailed: 72.00 less 90.00 is below zero, so the shortfall is 0.00.
